description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Radiator Reservoir/Over-flow Hoses.
The Long Hose goes from the Radiator Filler Throat to the Reservoir Tank
The Short Hose goes inside the Reservoir Tank
Genuine Suzuki OEM Hoses
Direct Replacement
What Will You Receive?
Qty 1 – Long Hose (Radiator to Reservoir Tank)
Qty 1 – Short Hose (Reservoir Tank)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
